title: Insecure temporary file via tmpnam (c) — review required
description: The c call tmpnam creates temporary files with predictable names or unsafe semantics, so a local attacker can pre-create or replace the file (symlink attacks). This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms exclusive creation or switches to mkstemp.
remediation: Create temporary files with mkstemp, which opens exclusively with tight permissions.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any tmpnam call matches regardless of directory protections.
